svg.text: Phase sampling stage: limiter, tapped delay line, 16 two-diode gates, readout
Concept schematic of the simulated circuit. Taps 2 to 14 repeat tap 1. Strobe chain values are targets and have not been simulated.
35 ps, 5.8 mm per section, both strobe lines
U3–U6: GVA-84+. Both chains identical and length matched;
STROBE_N is the complementary FPGA output.
1. Signal on the line: ±0.5 V, edge about 150 ps, AC coupled; line 60 Ω unloaded, about 50 Ω with the taps.
2. Tap spacing in signal time = signal section + strobe section = 70 ps (simulated: 72 ps mean).
3. Signal line 15 × 5.8 mm = 87 mm; strobe pair the same length, run in the opposite direction.
4. Gate: aperture 55–70 ps; captures 16–31 % of the line voltage with 220 Ω isolation and ±3 V strobe.
5. Comparator input: about ±20 to ±45 mV, peaking 6 ns after the strobe, gone after 100 ns. Latch 15–25 ns after the strobe.
6. ±VB rails = ±1.56 V: with 10 kΩ and 2 × 4.7 kΩ this leaves ±0.5 V reverse bias on the hold nodes. VTH about 0 V, from a DAC.
7. Comparator: TLV3502 or LMV7219. Input capacitance sets the signal: 3 pF assumed, 6 pF halves it. Bias current under 1 µA.
8. Tap stubs under 1 mm; Da/Dk, Ca/Ck and the 220 Ω resistors placed symmetrically about the tap.
